metadata.description: A hierarchical, incrementally updated map of a codebase for coding agents: briefs from the whole system down to its source files, kept current as the code changes.

plugins.name: hrono
plugins.description: Gives Claude Code the hrono map of the repository it is working in. Every prompt is matched against the map and the relevant passages are attached automatically; for questions about how the code is organised, Claude walks the exported map from the overview down to the source files. Configured per repository: which tree, which export folder, and whether automatic recall is on.
